name: Tepig
description: Tepig, the Fire Pig Pokémon. Able to evolve into Pignite. A Fire type.
pokedex_entries: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.
It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.
